paragraphs: Fermi Inc's stock price is 7.12, with a 21.09% change versus the prior close and a 12.84% change over a window of 22 sessions. The price is as of August 11, 2026. There have been 20 new news articles in the last 24 hours.

Recent news headlines include Fermi seeing unusually large options volume, an agreement with Hillcore to add 2.6 GW power capacity at a Texas AI campus, and the company finally securing a tenant for its Project Matador campus. Construction is also underway at the Project Matador campus.

There have been various SEC filings, including the appointment of new officers, the resignation of a director, and the issuance of $431.25 million in aggregate principal amount of convertible senior notes. There has been one Form 4 filing and no Form 144 filings.
